{{Textbox|boxtype=note|header=How a request for comments works|text=A request for comments (RfC) is used to assess internal projects or change proposals. Everyone concerned comments by the given end date – no more than two weeks should pass until the decision. Once accepted, the implementation tickets are created.|icon=yes}}

== 📝 Summary ==
Describe the idea in three to five sentences: what do you propose, and which problem does it solve? Readers should understand the proposal without any prior knowledge.

== 🛠️ Proposed implementation ==
How would the idea be put into practice?
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%;"
!'''Step'''
!'''Description'''
|-
|What needs to happen?
|Details about this step – who is involved and what is the result?
|-
|..
|
|-
|..
|
|}

== ⚖️ Advantages and disadvantages ==
{{ProConList
|title-advantages=👍 Advantages / opportunities
|title-disadvantages=👎 Disadvantages / risks
|advantages=
*Which problem disappears?
*Who benefits – and how noticeably?
|disadvantages=
*Which costs, risks or dependencies come with it?
*What could go wrong during the implementation?
}}

== 🎯 Affected areas ==
Which teams, processes or systems are affected – and in which way?

*'''Area 1:''' what changes there?
*'''Area 2:''' what changes there?

== ⏱️ Effort and schedule ==
Estimate the effort and name a realistic time frame.

*'''Effort:''' e.g. approx. 10 person-days
*'''Earliest start:''' mm/dd/yyyy
*'''Expected duration:''' e.g. 4 weeks

== 💬 Comments and evaluation ==
What does everyone think about the idea? Add your comment and sign it so that questions can be clarified directly.

*Comment – ''name''
*Comment – ''name''
